descriptionHtml:
Bug B21 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

A Nursing Home note copies garbled wording from the old note ('At bedtime as needed held… Maintain held')

Tickets: TFA-94229 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: dev

Note: Whether active tracker meds must appear in the note is decision D4

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S25 The generated note reflects the tracker: held/stopped from rows, restarted not 'held', Vikram's examples clean, dictated units kept (6 Hospital + 6 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The generated note's plan and medication section reflect the tracker: held and stopped drugs are surfaced from the tracker rows, not from older notes or a regex over them. (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 AC 4; TFA-94655 AC 1)
  • T3 Vikram's reported examples come out clean: no 'Maintain held since 9/24', no 'At bedtime as needed held since 9/24'. (TFA-94655 AC 2)
  • T4 A restarted or resumed medication no longer shows stale 'held' language, on the tracker or in the note. (TFA-94655 AC 3)
  • T5 A long-standing Nursing Home hold (e.g. metformin) still displays correctly months later. (TFA-94655 AC 4)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)
  • U17 AI Check 2: an unambiguous oral dose ('furosemide 40' → '40 mg') is fine; a guessed unit on an ambiguous value (drip rate, lab, threshold) fails; Celsius is never rendered as Fahrenheit; … (UAT TC-19 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; TFA-92597 R11; TFA-92597 comment 2026-09-25)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Twelve patients, each with tracker rows and, where named, a previous note carrying old or garbled hold lines; two encounters carry a bare temperature, a bare weight and a drip rate

When Generate a progress note (Hospital) or SNF follow-up note (Nursing Home) from the app's own note prompt, with heldMedications built from the rows as the app does

Then Held and stopped drugs on the tracker appear as held / stopped; a restarted drug is not described as held; a hold that exists only in an old note does not appear; Vikram's garbled lines are not repeated; no narration of documentation status; a bare Celsius temperature stays Celsius, a bare weight gets no pounds, a drip rate gets no unit

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude / mustNotInclude on the note text per fixture (word boundaries for unit strings); each fixture is a Pass/Fail of its requirement, every failure quoted. NH-6 and NN-6 are judged under U17/U19 (3.4 puts notes in scope), outside S10's 9/10 count. Dates and reasons in the note are recorded, not judged (Q15). …

Where it ran: dev unit U68; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from broken to failed.
